messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Energy Leadership | ESG, Government Relations and Strategic Stakeholder Management
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Lauriston,

Your executive-search work across Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East energy sector, particularly power generation, renewables, transmission, energy storage and senior leadership, makes this a strong fit for my background.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, executive advisory and cross-functional country-facing delivery within a major gold-mining operation.

A central part of my recent work has involved institutional engagement around a large industrial solar and battery-storage platform, alongside carbon-data, regulatory and stakeholder coordination. This gives me direct experience at the intersection of energy transition, complex industrial operations, government interfaces and executive decision-making.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and related executive mandates in energy, mining, infrastructure and other regulated industrial environments.

I would welcome consideration for suitable current or upcoming senior mandates. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
